title: String bass and the bass horn in the Eureka band
summary: He is now interested in learning string bass; he picked up the bass horn in the Eureka band around 1945-46.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Now, I played and- Excuse me, did you ever play string bass at any time in your life? No, I just waited until I got old as I am now to start taking it up.

Yeah, I have old one there and now I've got to try to get somebody to fix it up for me. If I can get it fixed up I believe I could play it. That's the interest I'm really interested in that now, in the string bass. But I've got old one and I want to try to fix it enough for me to play on it before I go buy a good one. I don't want to get no money to buy a good one. You know it might not get played but I have a old one. And for different orchestras I think I've played with practically all of them they have around you and yours.
I was going to ask you, when about was it that you picked up the bass horn in the Eureka band, the peak branch of the bass horn?
Oh that was around 19... About 1945 or 46 somewhere along there.
